mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.conversation_sessions ( session_id, user_id, mode, title, message_count, status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{sessionId}, #{userId}, #{mode}, #{title}, #{messageCount}, COALESCE(#{status}, 'ACTIVE'), NOW(), NOW() ) ON CONFLICT (session_id) DO UPDATE SET mode = EXCLUDED.mode, title = EXCLUDED.title, message_count = EXCLUDED.message_count, status = EXCLUDED.status, updated_at = NOW()
